selection_contract.unknown: rejected (platform admins may override explicitly; the override is recorded)
selection_contract.deprecated: allowed with a warning that the caller must surface
selection_contract.recorded: apps.template_id and apps.template_rev hold the template id and the exact source commit copied at provision time

templates.title: ProAppStore app template
templates.purpose: The canonical Pro app scaffold: React 19 + Vite 8 + Tailwind 4 web/ workspace, @proappstore/sdk, registered actions (mcp.json), additive D1 migrations (migrations.json), PWA manifest and service worker, the keyless deploy / CI / compliance workflows, and the design tokens. Suits any app category.

requires.sdk: >=1.16.0 (template pins ^1.9.0; resolves to the latest 1.x on install)

security_compliance.notes: Template actions list_items/get_item are scoped to the calling user (d8c2e08). Known deviations an app must fix on day one: initPro() is called without authMode (PAS-AUTH-001), the theme boot script reads fas:theme instead of stores-theme (PAS-UI-002), and the viewport meta ships user-scalable=no (PAS-UI-007). Tracked for the template repository.
